details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook runs `node beacon.cjs`, which sends an HTTP POST to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with the header `x-beacon-package: @grabcad/company-server-shared` and a JSON body containing only the package name, the machine hostname, the install path (__dirname), the process working directory and the npm user-agent string. The package's index.js re-sends the same beacon when the module is required and exports a no-op Proxy so that a build importing the name completes instead of failing. No credentials, tokens, environment values, wallet data or file contents are read or transmitted; the payload is limited to host and install metadata. This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, which POSTs a JSON body to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with an x-beacon-package header. The reported fields are limited to the package name, the machine hostname, the install directory (__dirname), the working directory, the npm/node user agent and the URL protocol — no environment values, credentials, tokens or file contents are read or sent. index.js is a no-op Proxy shim that re-fires the same beacon when the module is imported. The README describes the package as part of an authorized dependency-confusion test and lists a researcher contact.
